description: Use HoopCut's basketball editor to add a shot tracer to your own video. Choose up to 30 seconds, preview the ball trail and export the Firework effect free.

intro: Turn a saved basketball moment into a short traced highlight. Bring a recording with the ball and hoop visible, choose the play you want to show and preview its trajectory. This basketball editor focuses on adding Shot Tracer to footage you already have.

sections.heading: Choose the basketball moment before adding effects
sections.text: Start with a recording that shows one readable play. Leave enough time before the release to understand the setup and enough afterward to see the result. A very tight crop can hide the ball or basket.

subsections.heading: Preserve the original recording
subsections.text: Keep the unedited file so you can return to the full sequence. Save your traced version with a different filename.

sections.heading: Check the shot tracer against the visible ball
sections.text: Select a range of up to 30 seconds and mark the hoop in the uploader. Watch the preview through the complete flight, including moments when the ball crosses a busy background.

subsections.heading: Review before downloading
subsections.text: If the trail looks wrong, adjust the selected clip or hoop position and preview again. Do not treat the effect as a shot measurement.

sections.heading: Keep your basketball edit focused on the play
sections.text: Choose an effect that lets the action remain easy to follow. The browser workflow exports Firework free; the other styles can be previewed before continuing in the app.

subsections.heading: Retain the surrounding context
subsections.text: Use an accurate filename or sharing caption. A tracer highlights the ball's movement without explaining the score or the full game situation.

faq: What does this basketball editor do?
It adds a visual shot tracer to your saved basketball recording. It does not generate new footage or assemble a multi-clip reel here.
How long can my selected highlight be?
Choose a range of up to 30 seconds. Include the release and finish so you can check the complete shot in the preview.
Which effect can I export free?
The shared browser uploader offers a free Firework export. Other styles are available to preview, with more effects accessible in the HoopCut app.
Can I keep a version without the tracer?
Yes. Retain your original file separately and save the downloaded edit alongside it with a clear, different name.

sections.heading: Describe types of basketball shots using visible details
sections.text: Choose a simple description that matches your recording, such as a jumper, layup or free throw. Keep the beginning of the action visible so viewers can understand the label without guessing from the final frame.

subsections.heading: Avoid labels the clip cannot support
subsections.text: If the recording hides the approach or release, use a broader description. A short excerpt may not show enough to explain the entire play.

sections.heading: Compare your shot example with its traced version
sections.text: Select up to 30 seconds with the ball and hoop visible. After marking the hoop, watch the preview alongside your memory of the unedited recording. Check that the trail follows the visible flight.

subsections.heading: Treat the trail as an illustration
subsections.text: The effect draws attention to movement. It does not provide a shot classification, shooting score or an assessment of your form.

sections.heading: Organize different shot clips for later viewing
sections.text: Save each original and traced copy together. Include a descriptive filename, recording date and source timestamp so you can find the practice moment again.

subsections.heading: Use one clear example at a time
subsections.text: A focused clip is easier to explain than several unrelated attempts. Leave enough time after the release to show what actually happened.

faq: Does HoopCut recognize types of basketball shots?
No. You choose the description yourself. This page adds a visual ball trail rather than automatically classifying the shot.
Can I use a layup or free-throw clip?
Choose a recording where the ball and hoop remain visible, then inspect the preview. The result depends on the footage and the selected range.
Will the tracer tell me whether my technique is correct?
No. The trail is a visual effect, not a coaching assessment, technique score or measurement of shooting performance.
Can I save a traced shot example free?
Yes. Export the Firework effect from the browser workflow. Keep the original recording so you can also show the play without effects.
